{"command":"python3 -c "
import zlib, struct
data=open('leaf.png','rb').read()
# find IDAT
i=data.find(b'IDAT')
ln=struct.unpack('>I',data[i-4:i])[0]
raw=data[i+4:i+4+ln]
dec=zlib.decompress(raw)
print(len(dec), dec.hex())
# 8x8 RGB 8-bit: each row = 1 filter + 24 bytes = 25, total 200
"","description":"Decompress PNG pixel data"}
